title: Gerund, Infinitive, Conditional — Level 1 — Warm-up: gerund, infinitive, and if

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Which sentence uses a gerund as the subject?

visual.text: Reading every night improves my vocabulary.

choices.say: Reading every night improves my vocabulary.

visual.text: I read every night to improve my vocabulary.

choices.say: I read every night to improve my vocabulary.

visual.text: She reads a novel every night.

choices.say: She reads a novel every night.

visual.text: They want to read every night.

choices.say: They want to read every night.

items.reteach: Gerund (verb-ing) bisa menjadi subjek kalimat: "Reading … improves …".

items.prompt: Which verb is usually followed by a gerund (verb-ing), not a to-infinitive?
items.reteach: Avoid, enjoy, finish, mind, keep diikuti gerund: avoid eating. Decide, hope, refuse diikuti to + verb 1.

items.prompt: Which verb is usually followed by a to-infinitive (to + verb 1)?
items.reteach: Plan, want, decide, hope, refuse diikuti to-infinitive: plan to visit. Finish, mind, keep diikuti verb-ing.

items.prompt: In "Dimas finished painting the fence before noon", the word "painting" is …
items.reteach: "Painting" adalah gerund yang menjadi objek kata kerja "finished".

items.prompt: Which form of a verb comes right after a preposition such as "in", "of", "about", or "without"?
items.reteach: Setelah preposisi selalu memakai gerund: interested in joining, without saying.

items.prompt: Which sentence is a conditional type 0 (a general truth)?

visual.text: If you heat butter, it melts.

choices.say: If you heat butter, it melts.

visual.text: If I had a stove, I would melt the butter.

choices.say: If I had a stove, I would melt the butter.

visual.text: If she had heated the butter, it would have melted.

choices.say: If she had heated the butter, it would have melted.

visual.text: If I were a chef, I would use more butter.

choices.say: If I were a chef, I would use more butter.

items.reteach: Type 0: If + simple present, simple present. Dipakai untuk fakta umum.

items.prompt: Which sentence is a conditional type 2 (an unreal present situation)?

visual.text: If I lived near Ijen, I would see the blue fire.

choices.say: If I lived near Ijen, I would see the blue fire.

visual.text: If I live near Ijen, I will see the blue fire.

choices.say: If I live near Ijen, I will see the blue fire.

visual.text: If I had lived near Ijen, I would have seen the blue fire.

choices.say: If I had lived near Ijen, I would have seen the blue fire.

visual.text: If you live near Ijen, you see the crater every day.

choices.say: If you live near Ijen, you see the crater every day.

items.reteach: Type 2: If + simple past, would + verb 1. Artinya: kenyataannya saya tidak tinggal di dekat Ijen.

visual.text: an imagined result of something that did not happen in the past

choices.say: an imagined result of something that did not happen in the past

visual.text: a scientific fact that is always true

choices.say: a scientific fact that is always true

items.reteach: Type 3 (If + past perfect, would have + verb 3) membayangkan masa lalu yang tidak terjadi.

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Which sentence correctly uses "make + object + bare infinitive"?

visual.text: The long trip made the child sleep early.

choices.say: The long trip made the child sleep early.

visual.text: The long trip made the child to sleep early.

choices.say: The long trip made the child to sleep early.

visual.text: The long trip made the child sleeping early.

choices.say: The long trip made the child sleeping early.

visual.text: The long trip made the child slept early.

choices.say: The long trip made the child slept early.

items.reteach: Make + objek + verb 1 tanpa "to": made the child sleep.

items.prompt: Which pair of verbs is followed by object + bare infinitive (verb 1 without "to")?
items.reteach: Let dan make memakai bare infinitive: let me go, make him laugh. Want/ask/allow/tell memakai to + verb 1.

items.prompt: Which sentence correctly expresses a wish about the present?

visual.text: I wish I knew the answer.

choices.say: I wish I knew the answer.

visual.text: I wish I know the answer.

choices.say: I wish I know the answer.

visual.text: I wish I will know the answer.

choices.say: I wish I will know the answer.

visual.text: I wish I have known the answer.

choices.say: I wish I have known the answer.

items.reteach: Wish tentang sekarang memakai simple past: I wish I knew (kenyataannya saya tidak tahu).

items.prompt: "Sinta is good at drawing, but she is drawing a map now." Which "drawing" is a gerund?
items.reteach: Setelah preposisi "at", drawing adalah gerund. "Is drawing" adalah present continuous.

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Which sentence about the runner is grammatically correct?

visual.text: The runner hopes to win the race.

choices.say: The runner hopes to win the race.

visual.text: The runner hopes winning the race.

choices.say: The runner hopes winning the race.

visual.text: The runner hopes win the race.

choices.say: The runner hopes win the race.

visual.text: The runner hopes won the race.

choices.say: The runner hopes won the race.

items.reteach: Hope diikuti to-infinitive: hope to win.

items.prompt: Which pattern is used in a conditional type 1?

visual.text: If + past perfect, would have + verb 3

choices.say: If + past perfect, would have + verb 3

items.reteach: Type 1 untuk kemungkinan nyata: If it rains, we will stay home.
